paragraphs: Mar Tavi. Tavi son of Mari Tavi — [Rosh Hashanah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.22a.7).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading has Mar Tavi. The linked Bavli has Tavi, son of Mari Tavi, who cites Mar Ukva in Shmuel’s name.
[Heilprin’s Tavi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1572&lang=en) gives Tavi as Mari Tavi’s grandson, a different reading of the chain.
